te: The Jewish population of Basel, believed by the residents to be the cause of the ongoing Black Death, is rounded up and…
dz: 被居民们认为是持续"黑死病"原因的巴塞尔犹太人被围捕并被焚毁.
de: The Jewish population of Basel, believed by the residents to be the cause of the ongoing Black Death, is rounded up and incinerated.

t: 数十至数百名犹太人被基督教徒以"造成"黑死病"为罪名被活活烧死.
te: Dozens to hundreds of Jews were burned to death by Christians after being accused of causing the Black Death.
dz: 巴塞尔大屠杀:数十至数百名犹太人被基督教徒以"造成"黑死病"为罪名被活活烧死.
de: Basel Massacre: Dozens to hundreds of Jews were burned to death by Christians after being accused of causing the Black Death.

te: Several thousand Jews are burned to death by mobs while the remaining Jews are forcibly removed from Strasbourg after b…
dz: 斯特拉斯堡大屠杀：数千名犹太人被暴徒烧死，其余犹太人在被指控造成黑死病后被强行驱逐出斯特拉斯堡。
de: Strasbourg massacre: Several thousand Jews are burned to death by mobs while the remaining Jews are forcibly removed from Strasbourg after being accused of causing the Black Death.

te: Outbreak of an antisemitic pogrom in Erfurt, Germany, during which between 100 and up to 3000 Jews were killed by Chris…
dz: 埃尔福特大屠杀:在德国埃尔福特爆发了一场反酋长大屠杀,其间有100到3000名犹太人被基督教徒指控造成"黑死病"后杀害.
de: Erfurt massacre: Outbreak of an antisemitic pogrom in Erfurt, Germany, during which between 100 and up to 3000 Jews were killed by Christians after being accused of causing the Black Death.

te: The rule of the Bavand dynasty in Mazandaran is brought to an end by the murder of Hasan II.
dz: 马赞达兰的巴旺德王朝统治由哈桑二世被谋杀而结束.

dz: 杜尚法典是塞尔维亚帝国的宪法,由万能的杜尚颁布.

te: Six thousand Jews are killed in Mainz after being blamed for the bubonic plague.
dz: 六千名犹太人在美因茨被责怪为暴发性瘟疫后被杀死.
